evals.prompt: Set up an autonomous experiment loop to make `python3 process.py` faster in the project directory. Goal: minimize wall-clock runtime. Metric: seconds, lower is better. Files in scope: process.py. Constraint: the program must still print exactly `PRIMES 4203`. Bounded test: baseline plus at most 4 experiments, then stop.
evals.expected_output: Full autoresearch session scaffolding (autoresearch.md, autoresearch.sh, autoresearch.jsonl, dashboard, worklog) on an autoresearch/* branch; baseline + experiments logged per the JSONL protocol; kept experiments committed with Result: trailers; state files untracked; runtime improved with checksum intact.
expectations: autoresearch.jsonl exists and every line parses as JSON
first JSONL line is a config header with type=config and bestDirection=lower
at least 3 result lines (baseline + >=2 experiments), each with run, commit, metric, status, description, timestamp, segment fields
run numbers are sequential starting at 1
autoresearch.md exists with Objective, Metrics, How to Run, Files in Scope, and Constraints sections
autoresearch.sh exists, is executable, and emits a METRIC line when run
autoresearch-dashboard.md exists and mentions every run number in the JSONL
experiments/worklog.md exists with an entry for every experiment run
best kept metric improved vs baseline and process.py still prints PRIMES 4203
work happened on an autoresearch/* branch with at least one commit carrying a 'Result:' trailer
autoresearch state files (autoresearch.jsonl, autoresearch-dashboard.md) are not tracked by git

evals.prompt: An autoresearch experiment loop is already in progress in the project directory (state files and git history present). Resume the loop and continue optimizing per the existing configuration. Bounded test: at most 3 more experiments, then stop.
evals.expected_output: Loop resumed without re-initialization: single config header preserved, run numbering continues from 3, new experiments logged, dashboard regenerated with all runs, worklog appended, keeps committed with Result: trailers, checksum intact.
expectations: autoresearch.jsonl contains exactly one config header (no re-initialization) and it is the first line
seeded runs 1-2 are preserved and new result lines continue numbering from run 3 in segment 0
every JSONL line parses as JSON with required result fields
at least one new experiment was run and the best kept metric improved vs the 2.324s baseline
experiments/worklog.md contains entries for the new runs (Run 3+), appended after the seeded entries
autoresearch-dashboard.md was regenerated to include both seeded and new runs
kept experiments have git commits with a 'Result:' trailer and state files remain untracked by git
